characterList.description: Wearing a green long sleeve shirt and blue jeans. Has a wedding band on his left hand. He has a cut on his right index finger.
characterList.name: Man

content_metadata.description: A step-by-step guide on preparing breakfast while camping using a portable setup.

qAndA.answer: He uses diluted ethanol (85% ethanol with 15% water) because it is non-toxic and has multiple uses, such as a disinfectant and a drink.
qAndA.question: What is the man’s preferred fuel source for his stove?

qAndA.answer: He does this to prevent the Muesli from burning to the bottom of the pot, ensuring a cleaner cooking process.
qAndA.question: Why does the man put the Muesli in the pot after boiling the water?

qAndA.answer: The pot cozy is used to retain heat, allowing the Muesli to “simmer” even though the stove only operates at a high heat setting.
qAndA.question: What is the purpose of the “pot cozy”?

qAndA.answer: The water bag is an MSR Dromedary 6-liter bag.
qAndA.question: What brand is the water bag that the man uses to collect water from the river?

qAndA.answer: He wraps the pot stand pieces, stove, and leather pot holder around a coffee cup and places everything inside the boiling pot. The boiling pot and cozy go inside a sil nylon bag. He then puts tent pegs inside the bag as well.
qAndA.question: How does the man store his entire cooking system for travel?

youtube_description:
I put together this video to provide information to those who want to efficiently make a more nutritious version of oatmeal while camping. 

Equipment:

Stove: TOAKS Titanium Siphon Alcohol Stove https://www.toaksoutdoor.com/collections/stove/products/stv-01

Pot Stand: TiStand - TOAKS Titanium Alcohol Stove Dual Stand and Windscreen https://www.toaksoutdoor.com/collections/stove/products/frm-03

Kettle: Snow Peak titanium cup https://snowpeak.com/collections/cups/products/titanium-single-600-wall-cup-mg-044 or Lixada nearest equivalent in 650ml. https://www.lixada.com/p-y6017-7.html

Fuel Bottle: Trangia - Fuel Bottle 0.5L  https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07HG8NFDC/ref=cm_sw_r_tw_dp_x_1RdkFbE0AZVC9

Fuel: Everclear 190  https://www.caskers.com/everclear-190-proof/

Familia Swiss Muesli Original Recipe, 32 Ounce (INF-067) https://www.amazon.com/dp/B00MHTQGB4/ref=cm_sw_r_tw_dp_x_-6dkFb2RF9WMH

Canteen: Nalgene Tritan Wide Mouth Water Bottle https://www.amazon.com/dp/B002PLU912/ref=cm_sw_r_tw_dp_x_.SdkFb0HN7K5J

Medicine Spoon: 2 TSP 10 ml 10cc Calibrated Medicine Spoon https://www.amazon.com/dp/B01MRBIEAP/ref=cm_sw_r_tw_dp_x_TIdkFbSS8BQQC

Hotpad: scrap of suede

MSR Dromedary Bag Water Reservoir https://www.amazon.com/dp/B01MXWBD66/ref=cm_sw_r_tw_dp_x_egekFbPWQAJJ7

Pot Cozy: Reflective Thermal Aluminum Foil Radiant Heat Vapor Barrier Insulation https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07XPC4NF1/ref=cm_sw_r_tw_dp_x_o9dkFbMDR0KAH

Aluminum tape for Pot Cozy: 3M Aluminum Foil Tape 3380, Silver, 72 mm x 45 m, 3.25 mil https://www.amazon.com/dp/B009PPEVTW/ref=cm_sw_r_tw_dp_x_S-dkFb39Y9HMY

Campsite: Arnica Lane https://www.hipcamp.com/washington/charlie-s-s-land/arnica-lane
